description: Candidate embedding models for the 02E comparison runner, all reached through OpenRouter's embeddings endpoint via the existing provider abstraction (no direct OpenAI dependency, no OPENAI_API_KEY). This is a LIST OF CANDIDATES to measure, not a selection: the production model is chosen from measured, reproducible evidence by the owner.
availability: UNVERIFIED: whether each slug is actually served by OpenRouter's embeddings endpoint at run time has not been checked (no live call was made). A model that is not served fails its first call and is recorded as failed.
dimensions_note: Dimensions are the vendor's published defaults and are UNVERIFIED here; a returned vector of another width aborts that model with dimension_mismatch (OpenAIEmbedder checks every vector).
